items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Old man Joe Howell said... just come to my house. So I used to go to his house when he taught me.

ctx.x: Didn't know how to read then. Didn't know how to read.

When did you? Well I'll tell you, when I was playing with Humphrey, you know, Humphrey, well they had plenty of music, and I was playing drumming. Old man Joe Howell said, can you read? I said, no I can't. He said, well you're playing like you can read. I said, no. He said, well you're not, just come to my house. So I used to go to his house when he taught me. Oh yeah, Joe Howell. Yeah. What was he playing then? He used to be a trumpet in his days, young days, but during that time he was playing the tuba. During…
What did he have, how did he teach you? Well he got methods and all that, he understood it, you know. He got methods.
